headline: Mondelez International (MDLZ) Earnings Beat and Dividend Hike Reinforce Its Appeal as a Quality Dividend Stock
summary: Mondelez Q2 2026: adj EPS beat by 5.2%, revenue in line at $9.36B. Organic sales grew 2.2%, shares rose 2.3% after-hours. Full-year guidance maintained.

headline: Mondelez’s (NASDAQ:MDLZ) Q2 CY2026 Sales Beat Estimates
summary: Packaged snacks company Mondelez (NASDAQ:MDLZ) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 4.1% year on year to $9.36 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.73 per share was 7.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
